decision: 10 second time penalty. 1 penalty point (total of 5 for the 12 month period).
fact: Car 22 collided with Car 87 in Turn 6.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, and in-car video evidence. Car 87 was overtaking Car 22 at Turn 6 on the outside. Car 87 was well ahead of Car 22 at the apex. Car 87 clearly had its front axle ahead of the front axle of Car 22 at the apex and was driven in a controlled manner. Car 87 therefore had the right to the corner. Car 22 had a slight snap of oversteer and that resulted in a collision with Car 87. Car 87 then spun at the exit of Turn 6 and had to leave the track and rejoin after Turn 7. We therefore imposed a 10 second time penalty on Car 22 for causing a collision. We however, took note of the tricky conditions on track and imposed 1 penalty point.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 22 Causing A Collision
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
